entries.desc: The document defines the mandatory review floor for code-changing stories and the failure-triggered 3x1 escalation path.

evidence.note: The document defines zero-review code DONE as invalid, one review round for clean ordinary code, failure-triggered 3x1 local single-host audit, and high-risk 3x2/degraded fallback boundaries.

entries.desc: The document keeps docs-only typo/annotation changes in the one-round low-risk path and does not force every code change into 3x1.

evidence.command: rg -n "no material code diff|one-round low-risk|Do not force every code-changing story into three rounds" docs/requirements/decisions/review-assurance-floor-execution-plan.md && rg -n "Review Assurance Floor Execution Plan" docs/requirements/NAV.md
evidence.note: The document preserves the docs-only low-risk path, rejects forcing every code-changing story into three rounds by default, and is discoverable from docs/requirements/NAV.md.

entries.desc: The document does not claim 3x1 equals two-host review or Authority Server receipt-backed completion.

evidence.note: The document explicitly forbids treating local 3x1 as two-host independent review and forbids local evidence from claiming Authority Server completion or authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone/productionDone.

entries.desc: Three local single-host audit rounds are recorded as Non-authority evidence for the current document material.

evidence.command: lattice autopilot_review_status --storyId=B-503b --runId=B-503b-local-audit-r1 --format=json && lattice autopilot_review_status --storyId=B-503b --runId=B-503b-local-audit-r2 --format=json && lattice autopilot_review_status --storyId=B-503b --runId=B-503b-local-audit-r3 --format=json
evidence.note: Each run-specific status shows totalVerdicts=1, passingIndependentHosts=1, staleVerdicts=0, and a localReviewEvidenceRefs entry: r1 host-verdict:verdict-df35089fa5024a48, r2 host-verdict:verdict-12f2d912e2e9824e, r3 host-verdict:verdict-076efa73e2173746. Each is intentionally single-host local evidence, so status remains blocked for 2-host certification.

entries.desc: Each round checks the same core principles: no optimization for optimization, no arbitrary optimization, only real correctness issues, and consistency of logic.

evidence.command: run-specific status plus round notes in process-events.jsonl
evidence.note: Round 1 checked real zero-review code DONE gap, Round 2 checked consistency with threshold-triggered review escalation, Round 3 checked Authority boundary. The earlier incorrect default-run/x3 evidence claim was replaced with exact runId-specific status commands.

entries.desc: Audit results separate local Non-authority evidence from Authority Server proof and do not claim authorityDone, fullAuthorityDone, or productionDone.

evidence.note: Run-specific status reports authorityDone=false, fullAuthorityDone=false, receiptVerified=false, multiHostVerified=false. review_escalation_status reports authorityDone=false, fullAuthorityDone=false, productionDone=false. The evidence is local Non-authority audit evidence only.
